reason: The first pure-math run exceeded the preregistered 2e-12 absolute tolerance only for large stocks. Maximum closed-form discrepancy was 2.0345e-12 and maximum semigroup discrepancy was 3.6380e-12 on stocks up to 10000, i.e. approximately 1e-16 of stock scale. Mass balance was exactly zero and there were no monotonicity failures.
